data.title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | CodedCulinary
data.content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

These homemade blueberry scones are buttery, flaky, and bursting with fresh blueberries. They're easy to make and perfect with a cup of coffee or tea.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • Zest of 1 lemon

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch disc, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush with extra cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

data.content:
Classic Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 20 minutes | Cook Time: 15 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Yields 8 scones. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

Welcome to Coded Culinary, where recipes meet code! Here is our classic blueberry scones recipe:

**Blueberry Scones**
*Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 15-18 minutes | Yield: 8 scones*

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or two forks until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Gently fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Fold in blueberries carefully to avoid crushing.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
9. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
10. Let cool slightly before serving. Enjoy!

**Coding Tip:** This recipe can be modularized like a function—prep (parameters), mix (process), bake (execute), serve (return).

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Home | Recipes | About

These fluffy, buttery blueberry scones are quick to make and bursting with fresh berry flavor. Serve them warm with clotted cream or your favorite jam.

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 6 tbsp cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool slightly before serving.

Tips & Notes

result.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

These tender, flaky blueberry scones are bursting with fresh fruit and lightly sweetened. They come together in just 30 minutes and are perfect for a weekend treat.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla. Pour into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes, until golden brown.

Tips

For best results, keep all ingredients cold and handle the dough minimally to ensure flaky scones.

data.title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
# Blueberry Scones

A delightful, easy-to-follow recipe for fluffy, buttery scones bursting with fresh blueberries.

## Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup fresh blueberries

## Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, mixing just until combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
6. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet, brush tops with cream.
8. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.

## Tips
- For best results, keep ingredients cold and handle dough minimally.
- Serve warm with clotted cream or lemon glaze.
